description: Get the time remaining and end time for an in-progress timed quiz attempt. Read-only. Needs the submission ID from get_my_quiz_submission.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

submission_id.description: Quiz submission ID (numeric string), from get_my_quiz_submission.

name: get_quiz_submission_time
title: Get Quiz Submission Time
